description:
As mind blowing as the illuminating crystals are, the symbols and carvings on these relics are possibly of more importance. Full of suns, moons, planets, orbs aliens, triangles, third eyes, microchips and awash in geometric language, these are a puzzle that demands to be solved. ￼

Arturo has been doggedly researching these artifacts for 12 years and is a wealth of practical hands-on information concerning the subject. Please listen to his eloquent and detailed explanation at the end and let us know what you think in the comments.

Anyone wanting to go view these artifacts in person or interview me concerning the subject my email me here felz￼mediagroup@gmail.com
